purpose: Keep source-verifiable storefront capabilities separate from external provider activation, readback, and governance proof.

gates.description: Proves current Cloudflare DNS and Worker-route ownership for the branded front door. Activation is conditional and is only valid if read-only provider state proves the canonical route is absent.
completionRequires: exactly one canonical jussbeautifulhair.com Worker route owned by jussbeautifulhair-site
live /version identity equal to the approved exact SHA
desktop and mobile branded storefront proof
gates.conditionalMutation: Use the existing founder-authorized first-activation workflow only when read-only provider state proves the canonical route is absent.

gates.description: Proves the Founder Funnel Analytics Engine against the exact current release through workflow-visible read-only Cloudflare provider authority.
completionRequires: workflow-visible Cloudflare read-only credentials are present in the Production environment
exact-current-main Shopify production proof is green
exact-release Analytics Engine provider readback succeeds
retained Founder Funnel readback receipt binds repository, exact SHA, provider observation time, and result

gates.description: Proves GitHub itself enforces the intended main-branch merge membrane rather than inferring authority from source or CI.
completionRequires: provider-enforced pull-request path for ordinary main changes
only proven exact-head checks promoted to required status
fresh positive and negative enforcement readback

promotionRule: No gate may be reported VERIFIED from repository source, merge state, CI success, or historical browser receipts alone. Reacquire the relevant provider state and exact current source identity before every completion claim.

expiresOn: Founder Funnel provider-readback workflow or credential contract change
